# v1.4.0 — Unit Tests CI Job (CI-27)

Released: 2026-05-25

## Added
- `CI-27`: Add dedicated `unit-tests` job to CI pipeline (SQLite in-memory, no Postgres dependency).
  - Covers `src/`, `api/`, and `observability/` packages.
  - `--cov-fail-under=60` gate established.
  - Fast feedback loop before `integration-tests` runs.
